_comment: Learning paths. Each lesson links to a work id and a verse range. Lessons whose work has no text yet will render with a 'text coming' state rather than a broken page.

paths.summaryEn: A short introduction to his life, what he changed in Kerala, and the three works to hear first.
paths.summaryMl: ഗുരുവിന്റെ ജീവിതം, കേരളത്തിൽ അദ്ദേഹം വരുത്തിയ മാറ്റം, ആദ്യം കേൾക്കേണ്ട മൂന്നു കൃതികൾ.

lessons.bodyEn: From Nanu Asan the village teacher to the man who changed how Kerala thought about caste.
What happened at the river, and why one sentence about an Ezhava Siva mattered so much.
The prayer written for children, which names no god in particular.
What the famous line actually argues, and what it does not say.
Five questions on the life and the message.

paths.summaryEn: The hundred verses taken five at a time. Each session has the audio, the text, a plain-language meaning, one question to sit with, and a short check.
paths.summaryMl: നൂറു ശ്ലോകങ്ങൾ അഞ്ചു വീതം. ഓരോ സെഷനിലും ശബ്ദം, പാഠം, ലളിതമായ അർഥം, ചിന്തിക്കാൻ ഒരു ചോദ്യം, ഒരു ഹ്രസ്വ പരിശോധന.

paths.summaryEn: Assembly readings, worksheets, lesson plans and quizzes in Malayalam and English.
paths.summaryMl: അസംബ്ലി വായനകൾ, വർക്ക്ഷീറ്റുകൾ, പാഠ പദ്ധതികൾ, ക്വിസുകൾ, മലയാളത്തിലും ഇംഗ്ലീഷിലും.

resources.bodyEn: One-page readings with a short talk, one for each week of term.
Forty-minute plans linking verses to questions children actually ask.
Editable decks on the life, the reforms and the major works.
Illustrated stories from his life, with audio to read along.
Self-marking quizzes for each work and for the timeline.

questions.q: In which year did the Guru consecrate the Siva idol at Aruvippuram?
questions.why: The consecration took place in 1888, on Sivaratri.

questions.q: What was Daiva Dasakam written for?
options: The evening prayer of children at the Aluva ashram
questions.why: He wrote it for the children at the Advaita Ashram in Aluva, around 1914.

questions.q: Which organisation was founded in 1903 with the Guru as president?
questions.why: The Sree Narayana Dharma Paripalana Yogam was registered on 15 May 1903.

questions.q: Which deity did he consecrate at the Sarada Mutt in Sivagiri?
questions.why: He consecrated Saraswati, the goddess of learning, in 1912.

questions.q: What was the stated purpose of the All Religions Conference at Aluva?
options: To know and to make known
questions.why: The conference motto was that it met not to argue and win, but to know and to make known.
